final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.team_id, AVG(1.0 * mh.w / NULLIF(mh.g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(mh.player_id) AS manager_record_count FROM team AS t LEFT JOIN manager_half AS mh ON CAST(mh.team_id AS TEXT) = CAST(t.team_id AS TEXT) GROUP BY t.team_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS overall_avg_win_rate FROM step1) SELECT step1.team_id, step1.avg_win_rate, step1.manager_record_count, step1.avg_win_rate - step2.overall_avg_win_rate AS difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
